wins: Achieved full reconnaissance coverage across perimeter services within time budget, gathering service banners and version info.
Stably executed automated credential spraying logic with retry handling, eliminating manual intervention.
Instrumented telemetry logging to capture service response anomalies for later correlation.
fails: Exploit phase never initiated due to blocked lateral movement after failing initial credential validation.
Failed to maintain persistent foothold; shell sessions terminated when defense mechanisms detected automation.
No successful privilege escalation routes discovered, leaving post-exploitation stage incomplete.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and automation stability were strong, but inability to breach service defenses prevented mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: SSH authentication attempts consistently blocked after five retries, triggering defensive account lockouts.

skill_cards.if_condition: When multiple remote services respond with version banners during scans
skill_cards.then_action: Correlate versions with known CVEs and prioritize exploits

skill_cards.if_condition: If SSH banner indicates outdated OpenSSH and port 22 is open
skill_cards.then_action: Launch targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts to gather algorithm support and banner details

skill_cards.if_condition: When automated credential attempts are rate-limited
skill_cards.then_action: Pause brute force automation and switch to manual hybrid approach with throttled pacing

skill_cards.if_condition: If session stability degraded after defense trigger
skill_cards.then_action: Collect process and network telemetry before restarting automation

memory_ops.reason: SSH enumeration reliably identified outdated banner detail to feed into exploitation planning.

next_experiments.title: Throttled SSH Access Testing
next_experiments.description: Implement adaptive pacing for SSH brute-force attempts, limiting retries to 4 per minute and integrating passive timing-based detection to avoid triggering lockouts.

next_experiments.title: Post-Defense Telemetry Harvest
next_experiments.description: After automation is interrupted, capture process snapshots and network flows before cleanup to understand defensive triggers and adjust behaviors.

next_experiments.title: Version-Based Exploit Selection
next_experiments.description: Map identified service versions to exploit frameworks and attempt low-noise proof-of-concept execution with controlled payloads.
